dossier_meta.context_text: The paper establishes $r(H,K_{n}^{(3)})=2^{\Theta_{H}(n\log n)}$ for many $3$-graphs $H$, but no example achieving the purely exponential rate $2^{\Theta(n)}$ is known. The authors note that a specific constructed $3$-graph with $\frac{1}{3}<m_{\textnormal{pair}}(H)<\frac{1}{2}$, to which Theorem 1.1 does not apply yet $r(H,K_{n}^{(3)})\geq 2^{\Omega_H(n)}$ holds by Theorem 1.2, may be a promising candidate.
